plugins.name: verifying-production-readiness
plugins.description: Judge whether a system can ship: pin gates before the audit, grade findings by evidence (claimed/code/measured), run the product end-to-end, keep a cross-session defect ledger. Includes a machine ledger-lint and an HTML report renderer.
